Whichever text column comes first carries the row. Turn Payee off and Memo leads, at full size — nothing important ends up as small grey type. Drag the edge of a heading to widen it; click one to sort by it.
A filter never lies about the balance: when it hides newer rows, the ledger says so at the top instead of leaving you to wonder why today’s figure does not match the last line.
